purpose: Instantiate the directional product-material edge schema on actual Taiwan issuers across two economically different chains, preserving PARTIAL/UNKNOWN instead of theme inference.
rules: Current company/product pages can establish prospective exposure from capturedAt, but cannot be backfilled before their proven publication/knownAt.
Product capability or theme membership does not prove revenue share, cost share, customer order or realized margin.
A material is INPUT_COST to a downstream buyer even if material tightness is evidence of strong chain demand; economic sign remains unresolved until pass-through/margin/volume are observed.
UNKNOWN exposure is never treated as zero/no exposure.
Route-specific negative controls are preferred to generic same-sector controls.

productionRouteEvidence: Current official company profile lists manufacturing/sales of ABF substrate.
Current ABF roadmap separately lists Core/PP and Dielectric material families plus solder-mask/bumping material specifications.
issuerEdges.guard: Do not infer company-wide or ABF-specific cost percentages from product roadmap material lists.

productionRouteEvidence: Current official product page identifies FCBGA as a high-end GPU/CPU substrate solution and PBGA as based on resin-impregnated glass-fiber copper-clad laminate.
Current chairman message explicitly refers to large-area high-layer-count ABF substrates and capacity deployment/customer certification.
issuerEdges.guard: PBGA base-material structure must not be projected onto all FCBGA/ABF products.

productionRouteEvidence: Imported coal, iron ore and limestone feed raw-material preparation.
Iron ore/coke/flux feed the blast furnace to produce hot metal.
Blast-furnace hot metal plus scrap enter the converter for steelmaking.
issuerEdges.guard: Do not use scrap-price shock as if China Steel were a no-scrap control; it is a materially different exposure route, not zero exposure.

productionRouteEvidence: Official current sustainability disclosure states 2025 main raw material was 98% scrap.
Electric arc furnaces melt scrap to produce structural steel products.
Monthly production planning is linked to domestic scrap procurement.
issuerEdges.guard: Scrap-price sensitivity still requires selling-price, inventory, electricity/energy, mix and margin confirmation.

negativeControlPairs.interpretation: Route-specific exposure contrast only. China Steel has converter scrap usage, so this is not a zero-exposure control.
Do not assign a common material weight across substrate types; product-route-specific evidence is required.

reasonForD1012: SC-025 already recorded a L2->L3 data-feasibility promotion, but the canonical tracker was not synchronized. SC-023 now supplies bounded actual Taiwan issuer/product/route edges across electronics and steel, with official current sources and explicit UNKNOWN guards. L3 means PIT feasibility, not predictive efficacy or universe completeness.
